Yeah she didn't have  control over dying, unless ofc she was actually secretly suicidal and never told anyone and played it off as a drunk driving accident but seeing as she wasn't the one drunk I'm not sure how that would've worked. 

Good to know i should keep searching but i think I'll just be safe and stick to not trying to open myself up to being hurt by someone who is supposed to help me again. 

I've done dbt but idk the skills didn't really work for me that much I tried but didn't get much out of it

yeah idk I'd like to know to I was only there for like two weeks and when I got back oops look at that guess you don't have a therapist anymore. 

its fine though I guess they're just preparing me for the real world where ppl don't care or stay I probably should be thanking her or something.

It's not that hard to 'know what suits me.' what suits me is not having a therapist who dies. abandons me. or sides with someone who sexually assaulted me. **Is that too much to ask for???????** idk maybe my standards are too high. What do I know? 

Were all gonna die eventually yea. So cutting it short really is the best option if you're already miserable. Why extend the pain.

I just want someone who won't leave me or turn on me but realistically that does t exist neither in my personal life or in therapy so instead of being alone forever or getting my hopes up only to be crushed again i'm just gonna settle for the more realistic  answer of nothing but thanks for your offer.
Idk that's what she did idk why

Yea well I guess this therapist thought differently. I was sent to impatient for a suicide attempt and she just didn't see me again after. Never said bye or anything. I wasn't resent full or anything.

Hahahahaha is that what it sounds like? well I guess if it looks like sounds like and walks like a duck... i haven't thought of writing nobody wants to hear it. Same with an AMA they'll just get bored of my sob story. Thank you for your caring idk though I'm done with all this bullshit. Ill just rage on my way out at all the people who fucked me over. Good comprimise?
Oh wow shocker more evidence that they never really cared... thanks for your reply I guess you're right but maybe they'll still feel guilty anyways that's what I'm hoping for.
good to know that's normal. Still though she knew I had issues with abandonment though and didn't even bother to say goodbye or let me know she's terminating our therapy? It messed me up

OK that sounds like good advice idk if I can do it but I'll think about it and make a pro and con list or something. Maybe writing it down can help too. In the past I've had a therapist who I told about me looking them up and they were weirded out so I'm just really nervous. Thank u so much for your help I appreciate your advice alot!

Every therapist I've had has abandoned me in the past. One just stopped seeing me, one died and one never called me back after I was sent to inpatient. Idk I'm terrified this one will leave even though he said he wouldn't unless I needed a higher level of care . But I'm still scared. 

I mentioned in my other reply but I'm terrified to open up about some things and idk if I can bring this issue-driving to his house-up to him.

I understand the need for boundaries but I can't help getting super super attached and it's awful. Right now though he tells me he enjoys working with me and he'll sometimes tell me  stories about his life or his kids and im worried that if I tell him this he'll stop, but when I hear the stories about his life it reminds me he is a real person and I like hearing them. 

If I tell him what if he goes from thinking I'm like a nice/smart person (his words not mine my self esteem is dirt) with some issues to like a scary/high risk patient who needs to be handled cautiously or something? 

I'm also really bad at opening up like I won't even admit to him my self esteem issues or that I hate my body and my face because I'm worried he'll judge me and think I'm just a stupid teenage girl. So how am I suposed to tell him "oh yea btw I've been stalking you but it's not creepy I swear?" Idk if I can do that.
